# Design Lab — UI Design Brief

**Package:** `packages/design-lab`  
**Date:** 2026-07-24  
**Canon:** `DESIGN.md` (Microfilm Dark), `PRODUCT.md`, `docs/vision/{DESIGN_REGISTERS,UX_LANGUAGE_GUIDE,RESEARCH_NARRATIVE_RUBRIC}`  
**Sources:** `01–04` HTML surface prototypes + interface gallery / archival reference imagery  
**Sibling doc:** `DesignLabUiBrief.md` (architecture / modules / data flow)

---

## Purpose

`packages/design-lab` is the **visual sandbox and surface-concept archive** for Ultraterrestrial’s research product — not a standalone SaaS app.

It exists so designers and coding agents can:

- explore investigation UI before (or beside) wiring production React in `apps/app`
- keep a shared language for four research instruments: canvas, ledger, observatory, hypothesis lab
- port paper/dossier materiality into the live Research Canvas without inventing a second product aesthetic

====
# DesignLabUiBrief

**Created:** 2026-07-24  
**Package:** `packages/design-lab`  
**Skill artifact (full brief body):** [`02-ui-design-brief.md`](./02-ui-design-brief.md)  
**Pseudocode:** [`DesignLabUiBrief_PSUEDOCODE.md`](./DesignLabUiBrief_PSUEDOCODE.md)

This document summarizes the **architecture of the UI brief itself** and the **module / data-flow model** of the design-lab surfaces — so implementers can navigate from lab HTML → product without treating the sandbox as a second product.

---

## What `packages/design-lab` is

A **prototype + reference archive**, not a publishable app package:

| Asset class | Examples | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Surface HTML | `01`–`04` | Fixed artboard concepts for four research instruments |
| Gallery / refs | `00-interface-gallery.png`, dossier PNGs, textures | Materiality mood board |
| Missing link | `./document-system/ut-document-system.css` | Referenced by HTML but absent — gap |
